t: The Flomasta 22mm isolating valve is a plastic push-fit component designed for plumbing and hot water systems. This lightweight valve provides a strong grip and a secure, leak-free joint, making it ideal for both new installations and repairs in domestic and commercial properties. Its innovative push-fit connection with a locking mechanism ensures reliability in pressure and combination systems. The valve is compatible with various piping materials, including copper, PB, and PEX pipe, allowing for versatile applications. It is fully demountable and reusable, simplifying maintenance and modifications, and will not contaminate the water supply, ensuring potable water remains safe for consumption.
b: No Special Tools Required for Installation & Removal
